source.note: Patterns and syllabus text copied from the official SOF pages. Topic lists are the same syllabus split into short, plain names used for planning. Re-check the SOF site each year.

notes: Questions of level-I Olympiad exams will be 60% from the current class syllabus and 40% from the previous class syllabus. Questions in ACHIEVERS SECTION will be from current class syllabus only.
All questions are multiple choice with four options (A), (B), (C), (D) and one correct answer.
Answers are marked on an OMR sheet.
SOF lists sections in its pattern table in PRIORITY order (Achievers first); this is believed to be the tie-break order for ranking. Papers print sections in order 1 to 4.

IMO.subject: Mathematics
notes: Level 2 is held for the top qualifiers of Level 1 (Classes 5 to 10).

level_notes: Questions of level-I Olympiad exams will be 60% from the current class syllabus and 40% from the previous class syllabus. Questions in ACHIEVERS SECTION will be from current class syllabus only.
